title: Sync hardware clock with system clock
summary: Write the current system time to the hardware clock (BIOS/UEFI). This ensures the correct time is used after a reboot.

steps.explain: Set the hardware clock from the current system clock.

rollback.explain: Read the hardware clock to verify its current value (no direct undo, but you can set it again).

warnings: Ensure the system time is correct before running this command.
